rival_predictions.shape_orbit_interaction: the SD/M contrast changes under the energy-pitch dependent orbit operator

declared_invariants: source values are normalized cell masses with declared quadrature
SD and M match density and mean energy in every source radius-pitch cell
the same conservative orbit operator is applied to SD and M
identity orbit maps recover ZOW exactly
uniform and affine-moment controls cannot create an interaction
all three mode kernels are fixed before execution
protocol_effect: The fictional source family, radial critical-energy gradient, orbit map and mode kernels create the drive and interaction; none is calibrated to a plasma device.
withdrawal_condition: Withdraw the result if provenance metadata are incomplete, a conservation or negative control fails, fewer than two kernels converge, the interaction disappears under refinement, or deterministic reconstruction changes. A contraction of the represented orbit displacement under grid refinement classifies this version as a method failure.
